> {{ site.description }}

Key facts:

- Name: {{ site.title }} ({{ site.tagline | remove: '.' }})
- What it does: helps companies, boards and leaders explore and implement a Bitcoin treasury, from executive education to treasury policy, custody architecture, regulatory/tax coordination and accounting/audit support.
- Where: {{ site.organization.area_served | join: ', ' }}, with a founding team and local regional partners.
- Team: {% assign team = site.team | where: 'group', 'founding' | sort: 'weight' %}{% for m in team %}{{ m.title }} ({{ m.jobtitle | downcase }}){% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}. The team has used Bitcoin since 2013 and accumulated it since 2017.
- Approach: education first, then a documented brief, policy and custody design, and a handover with named owners. Legal and tax conclusions stay with the client's own qualified advisers.
- Website: {{ '/' | absolute_url }}
